newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: DMCI approves change in capital structure.
newsitem.headline: DMCI approves change in capital structure.

text.p: Shareholders of construction firm DMCI Holdings Inc approved on Tuesday the change in the structure of the company's authorised capital stock that would enable the firm to consider several financing options to fund projects.

The company's authorised capital stock, which remained at 1.75 billion pesos, has been changed to 1.65 billion common shares and 100 million preferred shares. Previously, its capital stock comprised 1.75 billion common shares.
The par value of each share remained at one peso.
In the same meeting, DMCI president Isidro Consunji said the company expects to hit a net profit of 839 million pesos and revenues of 4.683 billion pesos for the nine months ending Sept 30, 1996.
The company would be able to exceed its whole year net forecast of 849 million pesos, he said.

For 1995, the company reported an audited net profit figure of 494 million pesos. It had earlier reported an unaudited net profit figure of 510 million pesos. Revenues in 1995 were 3.817 billion pesos.
As of August 1996, the company's contract backlog reached 8.1 billion pesos, equivalent to 14 months of production, officials said.
